prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is now active. Use quick hotkeys or right-click your pet anytime to chat, hide, or send them to sleep.", "Basic Controls Guide"]
1: ["Define Your Pet's Personality", "Select key traits to shape how your pet behaves on your desktop."]
2: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Select Creation Method"]
3: ["Checking Desktop Canvas Permissions", "Ensuring your companion has permission to display smoothly over your windows."]
4: ["Signing in secures your adopted pets in the cloud so you never lose your progress."]
5: ["Finalize Your Adoption Certificate", "Give your pet a name and review their official adoption status."]
6: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life..."]
7: ["Claim Your Free Welcome Snack!", "Your pet is live on your screen. Give them a starter treat to complete setup!", "Bonus Starter Snack Unlocked"]
8: ["Choose Your Path", "Select a pre-made pet (takes 30 seconds) or design a custom companion (takes 2 minutes)."]
9: ["Quick Account Sign-In", "Sign In with 1-Click"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and bonus items
